description: Room name cleaning (cc_proto::sanitize_room_name). The server applies it to create_room.room_name; the result is relayed as room_name in join_pending and joined. `expected` null means the field is dropped (clients then show no room name). Same rules as the display name: control, bidi, zero-width and private-use characters removed, white space collapsed and trimmed, cut at max_chars; nothing left means absent.

vectors.note: nothing is left after removing unsafe characters
unsafe characters removed, white space collapsed and trimmed
line break is white space; BOM and private use removed
no trailing space after the cut
markup is not interpreted; clients show it as plain text
